metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2020 · The Call
metas.description: Two people live in different times. Seo-Yeon lives in the present and Young-Sook lives in the past. One phone call connects the two, and their lives are changed irrevocably.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2026 · Obsession
metas.description: After breaking the mysterious "One Wish Willow" to win his crush's heart, a hopeless romantic finds himself getting exactly what he asked for but soon discovers that some desires come at a dark, sinister price.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2026 · Resident Evil
metas.description: Follows a hapless courier tasked with delivering a package to a remote hospital. He soon finds himself caught in the middle of an outbreak and must fight through hordes of mutated creatures to survive.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2025 · Sinners
metas.description: Trying to leave their troubled lives behind, twin brothers return to their hometown to start again, only to discover that an even greater evil is waiting to welcome them back.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2025 · Weapons
metas.description: When all but one child from the same class mysteriously vanish on the same night at exactly the same time, a community is left questioning who or what is behind their disappearance.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2025 · Frankenstein
metas.description: Dr. Victor Frankenstein, a brilliant but egotistical scientist, brings a creature to life in a monstrous experiment that ultimately leads to the undoing of both the creator and his tragic creation.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2022 · Chup
metas.description: A lonesome florist with a new-found love interest and a psychopath killer who targets film critics in Mumbai. Are the two related? Inspector Arvind Mathur and Dr. Zenobia are about to find out.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2024 · The Substance
metas.description: A fading celebrity takes a black-market drug: a cell-replicating substance that helps her create a younger, better version of herself.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2020 · A Quiet Place Part II
metas.description: Following the events at home, the Abbott family now face the terrors of the outside world. Forced to venture into the unknown, they realize the creatures that hunt by sound are not the only threats lurking beyond the sand path.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2026 · 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
metas.description: As Spike is inducted into Jimmy Crystal's gang on the mainland, Dr. Kelson makes a discovery that could alter the world.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2022 · The Menu
metas.description: A young couple travels to a remote island to eat at an exclusive restaurant where the chef has prepared a lavish menu, with some shocking surprises.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2024 · Alien: Romulus
metas.description: While scavenging the deep ends of a derelict space station, a group of young space colonists come face to face with the most terrifying life form in the universe.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2020 · The Invisible Man
metas.description: When Cecilia's abusive ex takes his own life and leaves her his fortune, she suspects his death was a hoax. As a series of coincidences turn lethal, Cecilia works to prove that she is being hunted by someone nobody can see.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2024 · Nosferatu
metas.description: A gothic tale of obsession between a haunted young woman and the terrifying vampire infatuated with her, causing untold horror in its wake.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2022 · Prey
metas.description: Naru, a skilled warrior of the Comanche Nation, fights to protect her tribe against one of the first highly-evolved Predators to land on Earth.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2023 · Talk to Me
metas.description: When a group of friends discover how to conjure spirits using an embalmed hand, they become hooked on the new thrill, until one of them goes too far and unleashes terrifying supernatural forces.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2025 · Bring Her Back
metas.description: A brother and sister uncover a terrifying ritual at the secluded home of their new foster mother.
